mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS U JOIN USER_ROLES R ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID WHERE R.ROLE_NAME = 'ROLE_AGENT'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS U JOIN USER_ROLES R ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID JOIN AGENT_DETAIL A ON U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID WHERE R.ROLE_NAME = 'ROLE_AGENT' AND A.WORK_STATUS = '근무중'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS U JOIN USER_ROLES R ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID JOIN AGENT_DETAIL A ON U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID WHERE R.ROLE_NAME = 'ROLE_AGENT' AND A.WORK_STATUS IN ('휴식중', '외출중')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS U JOIN USER_ROLES R ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID JOIN AGENT_DETAIL A ON U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID WHERE R.ROLE_NAME = 'ROLE_AGENT' AND A.WORK_STATUS = '퇴근'

SELECT U.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_NAME AS userName, U.PHONE AS phone, A.WORK_AREA AS workArea, A.WORK_TIME AS workTime, A.WORK_STATUS AS workStatus FROM USERS U JOIN USER_ROLES R ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID LEFT JOIN AGENT_DETAIL A ON U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID WHERE R.ROLE_NAME = 'ROLE_AGENT' ORDER BY U.USER_NAME ASC
